about.title: Hashiwokakero, the bridges puzzle
about.intro: Hashiwokakero (橋をかけろ, “build bridges!”), also called Bridges, Hashi or Hashikake, is a Japanese logic puzzle published by Nikoli. Here you can play a new one every day for free, no account needed, and every puzzle has exactly one solution, so you never have to guess.
about.day: The same puzzle for everyone, new at midnight UTC. Like a newspaper puzzle, it gets harder towards Sunday.
about.clock: The puzzle stays hidden until you press Start. Only then does the clock begin to run.
about.penalty: Each check adds {{ check }} to your time, each hint {{ hint }}.
about.give_up: Stuck? Give up to see the solution. That run isn't ranked, but tomorrow brings a new puzzle.
about.tips_intro: Three deductions to get you started. Each picture shows the bridges they force.
about.account_a: No. You play as a guest right away and still appear in the ranking. Claim a name to keep your streak on every device.
about.next_q: When is there a new daily?
about.next_a: Every day at midnight UTC, at the same moment all over the world. A countdown on this page shows how long until the next one.
about.more_a: In <practice>practice</practice>: unlimited puzzles in five sizes, from 7×7 to 24×24, with hints whenever you like. Or build your own puzzles in the <workshop>workshop</workshop>.
